thread:
maria.k: Heads-up — planning an "hybrid" webinar for APAC + NA next Wed. Need a registration page that handles timezones, localized reminder cadence, and clean lead routing into HubSpot. Also: captions, cloud recording + SRT, and a post-event replay email flow. Who can own ops + messaging?

jonathan: I can own the registration page + funnel. Proposal: single-page reg with a timezone dropdown that writes a hidden `tz_offset` field so reminders can be scheduled in local time. Keep questions minimal (name, email, company, role). Add UTM params and a hidden `region` field set by IP -> used for segmentation.

ellen_marketing: +1. Messaging iteration: have 3 headline variants for the page (performance, cost, reliability). We'll A/B the headline and CTA. We should also add an optional checkbox for receiving product updates so we respect consent.

sam_ops: For zoom config: cloud recording (shared), timestamps in the cloud recording, enable "Audio Transcript" and auto-generate SRT. Also enable alternative host and auto-record to the cloud. If we expect high concurrency, enable webinar mode or use our Dedicated capacity for panel demos.

maria.k: Good. Can we draft the exact reminder schedule? Suggest: registration confirmation immediate, calendar invite (user timezone), 48h reminder local, 1h reminder local, and Day-Of 30m backup SMS for US registrants (opt-in).

jonathan: Implementing calendar invite via ICS with start time set using `tz_offset`. For HubSpot mapping use Zapier webhook that posts to our leads endpoint and sets `utm_source`/`utm_campaign`. Quick sample: 
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/12345/abcd \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","first_name":"{{first_name}}","tz_offset":"{{tz_offset}}","utm_source":"{{utm_source}}"}'
```
I will also add a dedup key `email+webinar_date` so we don't double-fire.

ellen_marketing: For replay email: send within 1 hour with 3 CTAs: full replay, short highlights (3 clips), and slide deck. Also add a 7-day nurture sending: personalized follow-up by segment (enterprise vs. startup). We'll prep assets during edit window.

sam_ops: Asset routing: cloud recording -> S3 bucket `marketing/webinars/2026-03-...` via our ingestion lambda. Also generate captions SRT and VTT. Set retention 90 days for quick edits, then archive. Create a clip task in Asana: tag owner + editing owner.

jonathan: For timezone UX: show both local time and original host timezone on the page, e.g., "Tue Mar 24 · 11:00 PDT (Tue Mar 24 · 02:00 SGT)". Add small copy: "We’ll send reminders in your local time."

maria.k: Accessibility: enable live captions in Zoom + upload editable SRT to release for translations. Let's also contract our translation partner for 3 languages (JA, KO, FR) — priority APAC.

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created by sam_ops — https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (Meeting ID: 123-456-7890). Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcript: enabled. Passcode: set.

marketing-bot: Reminder: add UTM tags to registration CTA: `utm_medium=email`, `utm_campaign=hybrid-launch-2026`, `utm_source=organic`. Also tag the HubSpot form `form_id: webinar_hybrid_launch_0326`.

ellen_marketing: Post-event funnel: 0-1hr replay email, 24hr clip highlights, 72hr technical deep dive for people who watched 50%+, and 7d qualification email with demo CTA. Add conversion goal in GA + HubSpot.

maria.k: Risks: timezone conversion bugs, failed Zapier webhook, or Zoom transcription delay. Contingency: if webhook fails, fallback to CSV export and manual upload within 4 hours. If transcription delayed, push a caption-only email and mark full replay as "processing".

sam_ops: I'll add health checks: test reg -> zap -> HS mapping in staging, and one dry-run meeting to validate SRT generation + cloud recording. ETA for ops tasks: 48hrs.

jonathan: I'll hand off a draft reg page and the form config by EOD tomorrow. Will include sample ICS generator and Zapier steps in the doc.

ellen_marketing: I'll produce 3 headline variants and 2 remarketing ad copy variants. Can the growth PM help with paid geo-targeting? @maria.k can you loop them in? :rocket:

maria.k: Yes — looping @growth-pm. Owners: jonathan (reg + zap), sam_ops (zoom + assets), ellen_marketing (messaging + nurture). Next sync: tomorrow 10am PT.

jonathan: noted. Starting the timezone dropdown implementation now.

sam_ops: starting the dry-run Zoom setup. Will post logs here once done. :white_check_mark:
